question: Cy's lorry carries 229 boxes on each of its 8 shelves, and Cy runs 2 lorries loaded exactly the same way. The boxes from both lorries are shared equally among 4 depots. Each box holds 6 jars of jam. Dee's warehouse holds 2 times as many jars of jam as one of those depots receives, so Dee's warehouse is the bigger stock. How many jars of jam does Dee's warehouse hold?

In the morning Ed's stall had 91 pies on the counter, but 6 pies were dropped and 68 pies were sold. In the afternoon Ed baked until he had 6 times as many pies as were left, and his mother brought 23 more pies from home. In the evening his brother matched the stock exactly, so Ed had 2 times as many pies as before. How many pies does Ed have now?

In the morning Fay timed her walk to school: 34 minutes to the bridge and 7 minutes from the bridge to the gate. Since she walks there and back, her daily walking is 2 times that. In the afternoon her friend Gus worked out that he walks 2 times as far as Fay does in a day, so Gus does more walking than Fay. Gus walks that daily amount on all 7 days of the week. In the evening Gus also walked 35 minutes to a friend's house. Gus records his walking in minutes rather than hours, since sixty minutes make one hour. How many minutes did Gus walk this week?

In the morning Hal's grandmother shared 35 dollars equally among her 5 grandchildren, and Hal got his share. Hal spent 1 dollar on sweets and then split what he had left equally among his 6 savings envelopes, one for each goal. In the afternoon his father put 77 dollars into Hal's holiday envelope. In the evening his aunt added 49 dollars to the same envelope. How many dollars are in Hal's holiday envelope now?

In the morning Ivy's gift shop had 238 candles on its shelves, which was more than Jo's shop next door had in stock. Ivy sold 108 candles before lunch, and 10 candles were broken by a customer. In the afternoon a delivery of 54 candles arrived. In the evening Ivy unpacked 33 candles from the storeroom onto the shelves. How many candles are on Ivy's shelves now?

Kai's training lap is 85 metres long, and he runs 6 laps every session. He trains on 7 days a week and kept that up for twice as long as he first planned, 2 weeks in all. His running shoes cost 90 dollars. On the last day he also ran 6 extra metres to the finish line. How many metres did Kai run in total?

Lin's delivery van covers 187 kilometres on its regular weekly route, plus 18 kilometres to the depot and 62 kilometres to the coast each week. She drove that same weekly distance for 8 weeks, which is more than Mia's van covered in the same time. In the last week she also drove 41 kilometres to a special delivery. How many kilometres did Lin's van cover over those 8 weeks?

Nia started the trivia final with 24 points on her scoreboard. She earned 62 points in the history round and then lost 57 points in the science round. In the first bonus round every point on her scoreboard became worth 8 points, and a correct picture question then added 43 points. In the last bonus round every point on her scoreboard again became worth 8 points. How many points did Nia have at the end?

In the morning Omar stocked the top shelf of a rack with 98 boxes and the bottom shelf with exactly the same number, so the rack held twice that many boxes across its 2 shelves. He stocked 7 racks the same way, and then placed 21 loose boxes on a pallet beside them. In the afternoon a lorry took 999 boxes from the warehouse, and a courier returned 24 boxes that had been refused. In the evening 51 boxes were found to be damaged and were thrown away. How many boxes does Omar's warehouse hold now?

In the morning Yan's tip tin held 45 cents, and customers added 66 cents and then 33 cents. A generous regular then matched what was in the tin, so it held 2 times as much as before. In the afternoon Yan took 208 cents out of the tin to pay for a lunch delivery. In the evening he took 39 cents out for a bus fare. Yan counts in cents rather than dollars, knowing that one hundred cents make a dollar. How many cents are in the tin now?

In the morning Zoe's crate at the market held 214 apples, and she sold 97 of them before lunch. In the afternoon a farmer added 71 apples to the crate. In the evening Zoe decided that the number of apples in the crate at that moment would be her fixed daily order for each of the 5 market days in every week of the 9-week season. How many apples will Zoe order for the season?

In the morning the crew set out 125 chairs in the main hall and then squeezed in 77 more. The centre has 9 halls, and every hall was set out with exactly that number of chairs. In the afternoon 68 extra chairs were added around the halls for latecomers. In the evening, after the talks, the crew stacked away half of all the chairs. How many chairs were still set out in the evening?

In the morning the tea tent filled its first urn with 71 cups of tea and then topped it up with 17 more cups, and all 5 of its urns were filled the same way. In the afternoon the volunteers made 45 extra cups on a camping stove. The tent is 8 metres wide. In the evening the organiser calculated that the tent would serve exactly the same number of cups on each of the 8 days of the show. How many cups of tea will the tent serve over the show?

In the morning Eli's phone showed 105 minutes of calls left, and he bought a 34-minute top-up. He then made a 77-minute call to his sister. In the afternoon he made a 20-minute call to the garage. In the evening a promotion made his remaining balance 4 times as large, and a free 20-minute credit was added on top, which he thought was worth a dozen cheers. The plan shows the balance in minutes rather than hours, and sixty minutes make one hour. How many minutes does Eli have now?

A knitting machine at Fay's mill produces 82 scarves an hour and runs 8 hours a day, 7 days a week. Each week the finishers also hand-knit 14 scarves. The mill is 3 kilometres from the station. The mill kept up that weekly output for 5 weeks to fill a winter order. How many scarves did the mill produce for the order?

On Saturday morning Gus had 47 dollars in his wallet, spent 39 dollars on groceries, and then earned 38 dollars mowing a lawn. In the afternoon he spent 24 dollars on a haircut and earned 74 dollars washing cars. His car is 11 years old. In the evening his sister repaid 23 dollars she owed him, and he spent 39 dollars on pizza for the family. How many dollars does Gus have now?

In the morning Hana's delivery van had 109 litres of fuel in the tank, and the long morning round used 84 litres. In the afternoon a trip to the coast used 23 litres. In the evening she poured 5 litres in from a spare can and then drove to the depot, which used 3 litres. Hana logs fuel in litres rather than millilitres, since one thousand millilitres make a litre. How many litres are in the tank now?

Ivo is paid 217 cents an hour for his shift at the bakery, and he works 5 hours a day. Every day he also gets a 75-cent tip from the same regular. He worked 2 days this weekend and put all of it in his jar, then took 363 cents out for a bus pass. His mother then put 50 cents into the jar. Ivo counts in cents rather than dollars, knowing that one hundred cents make a dollar. How many cents are in Ivo's jar?

In the morning Lia's cleaning crew logged 119 minutes at the school and 31 minutes at the library, and then 28 minutes at the clinic. In the afternoon they logged 70 minutes at the town hall and 13 minutes at the bus station. The crew's van is 9 years old. In the evening they logged 75 minutes at the theatre, and the day's total was shared equally among the 4 members of the crew for their timesheets. Lia records time in minutes rather than hours, since sixty minutes make one hour. How many minutes were put on each crew member's timesheet?

The village water tank held 170 litres on Monday morning. Rain added 21 litres on Monday, 55 litres on Tuesday, and 65 litres on Wednesday. The tank is 2 metres tall. On Thursday 27 litres were drawn off to wash the church steps, and on Friday 217 litres were pumped out to water the cricket pitch. How many litres are in the tank now?

Priya tracks her swimming in metres, converting any distance her coach gives in kilometres into metres before it goes into her log. On Monday morning she swam 8 sets of 165 metres each. In the afternoon she added a cool-down of 20 metres, and in the evening she swam another 56 metres. She repeated exactly the same Monday programme on each of 4 days that week. On the last of those days she finished the evening session with a final 10 metres of gentle backstroke. How many metres did Priya swim in total that week?

Marta began the week with 195 dollars in her purse. On Monday she paid 125 dollars for a monthly train pass. On Tuesday her friend Leo repaid the 36 dollars he had borrowed from her, which left Leo with less money in his own wallet than Marta had in her purse. On Thursday Marta spent 76 dollars on groceries, and on Saturday she earned 25 dollars babysitting. How many dollars does Marta have in her purse at the end of the week?

Ana keeps her bead collection on strings. She had 81 strings, but she used 52 of them to make bracelets for a school fair. Each of the remaining strings carries 5 beads. She then bought a second, identical set of strings, so she had twice as many beads as before. Finally she took all the beads off the strings and sorted them into pouches of 5 beads each. How many pouches did Ana fill?

Each morning at Greenfield Farm the packing crew fills crates with 117 punnets of strawberries in each crate, and 9 crates make up one pallet. Each afternoon 8 of those pallets are loaded onto the lorry. The farm keeps this up for 6 days of the harvest week. The weighing scales read in kilograms, but the crew notes all weights in grams. The farm has been in the family for half a century. By Saturday evening the supermarket reported that 18680 of those punnets had been sold, and the rest were still on the shelves. How many punnets were still unsold on Saturday evening?

Hana's tutor talks about study time in hours, but Hana writes everything in her planner in minutes, so she converts what the tutor says. Each week Hana studies Spanish for 79 minutes on Monday, adds 45 minutes on Wednesday and 20 minutes on Friday. She kept exactly that weekly routine for 5 weeks. Her textbook has 312 pages. At the end she added 7 minutes of extra vocabulary review and then a 35-minute mock exam. She has been learning Spanish for half a year. How many minutes of study did Hana record in her planner over this period?
